summary: Chan voted for a Gaza ceasefire on the SF Board of Supervisors in January 2024, then consistently escalated: she calls the war a genocide, demands a full arms embargo and end to all US military aid, pledged to co-sponsor the Block the Bombs Act, and told The Intercept she would not fund Iron Dome. Track AIPAC and CAIR Action endorsements, an Ally rating from Vote for Peace, and a standing pledge to reject AIPAC money complete the record.
